_about: Model and GPU tables the Studio offers. Edit here, not in the code. scripts/check_catalog.py checks that the Hugging Face ids still exist.

huggingface: ZeroGPU: Hugging Face's shared GPUs (free daily quota)

upscale_x2.label: Real-ESRGAN x2
upscale_x2.memory: about 2-4 GB of GPU memory, any NVIDIA GPU. Tested on a Kaggle T4: about 40 s per clip

upscale_flashvsr.label: FlashVSR v1.1
upscale_flashvsr.memory: 8 GB minimum (it tiles), 16 GB+ recommended. Ampere or newer GPU only (RTX 30/40/50, A100, L4; not a T4); the first run builds a CUDA kernel: 20-60 minutes, about 32 GB of system RAM and the CUDA compiler. Not tested yet
upscale_flashvsr.short: 8 GB min, 16 GB+ best; RTX 30 or newer

upscale_seedvr2_3b.label: SeedVR2 3B
upscale_seedvr2_3b.memory: 24 GB for full speed; 8-16 GB works with block swap (slower) and wants 32 GB of system RAM. Not tested yet

upscale_seedvr2_7b.label: SeedVR2 7B
upscale_seedvr2_7b.memory: 40 GB+ for full speed, 24 GB with its fp8 model; 12-16 GB works with block swap (very slow) and wants 32-64 GB of system RAM. Not tested yet
upscale_seedvr2_7b.short: 12-16 GB very slow, 24-40 GB+ full speed
